** NNG

=84aa701f42968bf536141a24e826da66963b571a=:

NNG is distributed under the MIT license in =nng/LICENSE.txt=. To update it,

commit recorded here and in the build documentation, then run the upstream NNG
tests before running Nostril's clean build and transport tests.
